fields.name: Pettenderly
fields.description: Pettenderly turns everyday pet photos into downloadable AI portraits. Start with one to five clear photos of the same pet, with its eyes and coat markings visible. Each photo can be a JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB. Choose a watercolor look, a royal costume, a sunny window-seat scene or a studio portrait, then create your image. When you like a result, revisit My creations to download your favorite portrait as a digital image. Two beta tools add more ways to use your photos. You & your pet combines separate person and pet reference photos into a single portrait of the two of you together. Photo cleanup lets you describe a simple change, such as removing a cable from the background, and the tool edits the scene for you. As with all generative AI, faces, markings and fine details can vary between generations, so creating more than once is the best way to get a result you love. Each successful image uses one credit, while failed generations do not use credits. Buy a one-time Starter Pack for twelve credits, or choose a Pro subscription for a monthly allowance of forty credits. There is no free plan, and no physical print or shipping is included. The result is a digital image you can download and keep.
